info.title: PitSeeder
info.description: Command-line tool for seeding, exporting, and querying JsonPit data stores. Supports WWWA foreign key resolution, JSON export to file or stdout, piping to jq, and read-only audit of JsonPit recovery events.

options.name: --json
options.description: 	export to stdout (for piping to jq, grep, etc.)

options.name: --wwwa
options.description:
	operate on all 4 pits (Person, Object, Place, Activity)
--retain-window		keep this CLI process activity window until its normal timeout
